description: Direct drawing calls under src/controls/ (tools/paint_census.py); the stage T4 gate is zero stock calls. The census may only fall. Effect-canvas calls (effect_calls) are the effect engine's sanctioned path and are not stock calls.

exempt.basic/basic_control_rendering.cpp: the authored-recipe path: paint_theme_cues paints the focus and default cues of a control's own override recipes (visual_recipes_override), which the theme engine does not draw (owner decision, 2026-11-03)
exempt.connected_controls/connected_controls.cp: the authored-recipe path: the public paint_connected_surface_material paints an application's own recipe, which the theme engine does not draw (owner decision, 2026-11-03)
exempt.drawing_surface/drawing_surface.cpp: draws the application's own drawing (DrawingSurface), not chrome
exempt.easing_preview/easing_preview.cpp: draws application content (owner decision T4-4, 2026-11-01); only its frame and background go through the theme
exempt.metrics_view/metrics_view.cpp: draws application content (owner decision T4-4, 2026-11-01); only its frame and background go through the theme
exempt.panel/material_panel/material_panel.cpp: authored material: MaterialPanel paints the material its application gives it, as content (owner decision, 2026-11-03)
exempt.panel/picture_box/picture_box.cpp: draws application content (owner decision T4-4, 2026-11-01); only its frame and background go through the theme
exempt.panel/text_box/text_box_decorations.cpp: content paint (owner ruling, 2026-11-09): the backgrounds and underlines of a TextBox's styled runs are application content authored by the producer (a syntax highlighter, a spell checker), like the text itself, not chrome; the inks a decoration takes from the theme still resolve through the theme
exempt.raster_canvas/raster_canvas.cpp: draws the application's raster (RasterCanvas), not chrome
draws application content (owner decision T4-4, 2026-11-01); only its frame and background go through the theme; its line boxes are diagnostic inspection content (as VisualInspectorView's, owner-agreed exemption)
exempt.visual_inspector_view/visual_inspector_v: a diagnostic instrument: the inspector's dark panel stays fixed under every theme so that it reads the same while inspecting any of them (owner decision, 2026-11-03)
